annotations.title: Polyrank AI Lab assistant: one chat

description: One of your AI Lab assistant chats: its status, the questions and the assistant's answers with their notices and result cards (backtests, shortlists, strategies, tables). While a question waits, `queue_position` says how many are ahead; `awaiting_backtests` counts backtests the assistant started whose result will be posted to the chat by itself. Backtest and paper figures are SIMULATED. Needs a signed-in Polyrank account. Strategies, backtests, paper runs and chats exist only on a plan with the AI Lab (every paid plan, from Pro Trader: https://polyrank.app/pricing).

last.description: Only the last N messages (default all).
